subject: Pen test artifacts curation + spreadsheet sync for Newport Analytics
messages:
From: Laura Simmons <laura.simmons@newport-analytics.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: GRC Portal <grc-admin@newport-analytics.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: pen test report + SIG/CAIQ mapping for SOC2 evidence

Hi Sean,

We completed our vendor onboarding review and need the penetration test artifacts referenced on page 4 of the SOC2 evidence matrix. Specifically we need: a redacted pen test report (no customer data or contractor PII), a SIG mapping that ties each SIG question to the relevant section(s) of the report, and a CAIQ/CAI mapping CSV suitable for import into our GRC portal.

The GRC portal ticket is GRC-4127; ideally the artifacts are uploaded to the portal or to our SFTP by Aug 6 so the audit window stays on schedule. If you prefer, share a Drive folder and we can pull from there.

Deliverables checklist we expect:
- Redacted PDF (PDF, redactions visible)
- SIG mapping (CSV) with question IDs in first column
- CAIQ mapping (CSV)
- Simple artifact inventory spreadsheet (who produced each artifact, retention date)

Do you have an internal redaction policy we follow or should we use the default (remove customer identifiers + screenshots)? Also let us know if you will include an attestation signed by your security lead.

Thanks,

Laura Simmons
CISO, Newport Analytics
laura.simmons@newport-analytics.com

---
Attachment(s): none in initial request (portal ticket linked)

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood-inference.com>
To: Laura Simmons <laura.simmons@newport-analytics.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood-inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2027 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: pen test report + SIG/CAIQ mapping for SOC2 evidence

Hi Laura — thanks for the clear ask. We're on it. Quick plan:
- Naomi will handle redaction and produce a redacted PDF + inventory.
- Marissa will prepare SIG/CAIQ mapping CSVs and perform the portal upload.
- I'll coordinate any attestation signature and confirm the final upload.

Two quick clarifying questions:
1) Redaction level: do you need removal of all internal hostnames and code snippets, or only customer-identifying info?
2) Do you require the original findings CSV (raw vulns) alongside the redacted report, or is the mapped CSVs sufficient?

We should be able to deliver a first-pass redacted PDF and inventory by EOD Aug 2 and complete portal upload by Aug 3 so it fits your Aug 6 window. I will attach a preliminary redaction checklist and the first-pass redacted PDF once Naomi completes it.

Sean Gallagher
Senior Security Program Manager
Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood-inference.com
---
Attachment(s): redaction_checklist.md (planned)

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood-inference.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood-inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Laura Simmons <laura.simmons@newport-analytics.com>
Date: Sat, 31 Jul 2027 15:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: pen test report + SIG/CAIQ mapping for SOC2 evidence

On Fri, Jul 30, 2027 at 10:02 AM Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood-inference.com> wrote:
> Two quick clarifying questions:
> 1) Redaction level: do you need removal of all internal hostnames and code snippets, or only customer-identifying info?

Hi all — tagging in to confirm redaction approach. Our standard for external artifact release is:
- Remove customer PII (names, emails, IPs tied to customers)
- Mask internal hostnames and non-public internal endpoints (replace with HOST_REDACTED)
- Remove reproducible exploit code blocks; keep high-level descriptions of finding and risk rating

I'll produce:
- redacted-pen-test-v1.pdf (redactions visible),
- artifact_inventory.xlsx (mapping of artifacts and source), and
- a small CSV export of raw findings with columns obfuscated (if Newport wants it).

Naomi Feldman
Security Engineer, Offsec Team
Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood-inference.com
---
Attachment(s): redaction_checklist.md, artifact_inventory_template.xlsx

From: Laura Simmons <laura.simmons@newport-analytics.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood-inference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: GRC Portal <grc-admin@newport-analytics.com>
Date: Sun, 01 Aug 2027 08:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: pen test report + SIG/CAIQ mapping for SOC2 evidence

Thanks Naomi — that redaction policy sounds good. Confirmed asks:
- We need both a SIG mapping (CSV keyed by SIG question id) and a CAIQ mapping (CSV).
- The portal expects a CSV import for mappings; if you can match our header rows we can import directly. I attached the portal import template to ticket GRC-4127.

We also accept the artifact inventory in XLSX. If the redacted PDF is > 20 MB you can SFTP to sftp://evidence.newport-analytics.com/uploads/newport-evidence and post a note in the ticket with filename + checksum.

One additional ask: a short attestation line in the cover page signed by a security manager (PDF signature or plain text sign-off is fine) saying: "This report has been redacted in accordance with vendor data-sharing policy; no customer-identifying information is present."

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Laura
---
Note: GRC ticket: https://grc.newport-analytics.com/portal/tickets/GRC-4127

- Naomi: please deliver final redacted PDF + artifact_inventory.xlsx to the shared Drive folder by EOD Aug 2. I will convert mappings to the portal CSV template and perform the import on Aug 3 early morning.
- Signature: Sean, can you confirm who will add the attestation line to the cover page? I can add the text but prefer the security manager to sign-off.

Upload playbook attached (short checklist for portal import and required fields).

Marissa Cole

Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com

Upload complete and ticket updated (GRC-4127). Summary of deliverables uploaded:
- redacted-pen-test-v1.pdf (cover page includes attestation: "This report has been redacted in accordance with vendor data-sharing policy; no customer-identifying information is present." Signed: Sean Gallagher, Senior Security Program Manager)
- sig_mapping.csv (headers matched to portal template)
- caiq_mapping.csv (CSV for CAIQ fields)
- artifact_inventory.xlsx (producer + retention column filled)

Portal upload notes:
- Import ran successfully at 2027-08-03T14:12:00-07:00, portal ticket GRC-4127 shows status: evidence received.
- Files were uploaded via the portal UI; small artifacts were placed in shared Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redaction-folder
- No PII was included; internal hostnames replaced with HOST_REDACTED.

Laura — please confirm you see the artifacts in the portal and close the ticket when verified. If Newport prefers SFTP for any large binary evidence for future uploads, let us know and we will provide PGP-encrypted bundle.

Thanks — good teamwork.

Sean Gallagher
Senior Security Program Manager
Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood-inference.com

Attachment(s): redacted-pen-test-v1.pdf, sig_mapping.csv, caiq_mapping.csv, artifact_inventory.xlsx
